dogecoin.text: @Cointelegraph We filed a critical security report to @coinbase two weeks ago about the DogeReaper vulnerability on #dogecoin. As far as we know, coinbase still hasn't patched!
@eCash tech can stop these reorgs in their tracks at low cost. Only need a handful of whales to stake their @dogecoin. No hardfork required!
There's more we can do than just hashrate and node count to protect Dogecoin. Ever heard of Avalanche?
